qualification_sequence.gate: Acquire only into new ignored evaluation storage when qualification proceeds, verify every actual byte hash/size and license/source/conversion lineage. Capture full GGUF metadata/tokenizer/template and all projector metadata. Freeze synthetic development images/queries and expected outcomes before model output. Separate development and future unseen validation; never reuse Fresh40 as blind.

Start with text-only strict prompt/EOG controls then one image per request: printed synthetic text, shapes/counts, rotation/EXIF, empty/corrupt/oversized/unsupported input and deliberate image-free absence. Keep same pixel inputs, instruction, image token budget, context and bounded decoding. Compare expected facts, unsupported claims and text-only degradation. Cross-export results remain confounded until base weights/quantizer/preprocessing/template equivalence is demonstrated.

Separate test-only build; actual XML and raw JSON plus APK/native/model/companion/template hashes. Prove missing/wrong hash and mismatched projector refusal, truncated FD, process death/rebind, cancel during preprocess/prefill/decode, lock during each phase, stale callbacks and no app/network bypass. No owner content.

Exactly one runner after connection and normal owner unlock. Measure cold/warm load, image preprocess/prefill/first-token/decode separately, at least two warmups and ten recorded repetitions for each successful bounded cell, simultaneous app+runtime+projector+KV/image peak PSS, OOM/thermal state, cancel and hard-lock. Start one512px image and4096 context; larger cells require a justified budget. Existing static RAM/core claims and E4B effective parameter count are not memory acceptance.

Publish every failed cell, source/toolchain/artifact hashes, raw outputs and provenance, exact missing cells and reproducibility limits. m6v/rni/0xat and5hr remain open. A later explicit authorized integration decision is required before production runtime/default or capability activation.
